scenes.title: One distance, two rulers, two entropy values

sentences.en: One unknown distance, two rulers. Can changing units change its entropy?
sentences.zh: 同一个未知距离，两把标尺。换单位会改变它的熵吗？

sentences.en: Let the distance be uniform from zero to one centimeter.
sentences.zh: 设距离在零到一厘米之间均匀分布。

sentences.en: In centimeters, its interval is zero to one. In meters, the interval is zero to .01.
sentences.zh: 用厘米记录，区间是零到一；用米记录，区间是零到0.01。

sentences.en: The density-based entropy is zero on the first scale, about negative 6.64 bits on the second.
sentences.zh: 第一种尺度的密度熵为零，第二种约为负6.64比特。

sentences.en: Did converting centimeters to meters destroy information?
sentences.zh: 把厘米换成米，难道破坏了信息吗？

sentences.en: No. Differential entropy depends on coordinates. We will derive the correction and compare mutual information.
sentences.zh: 没有。微分熵依赖坐标。接下来推导修正量，并与互信息比较。

sentences.en: Let X have a probability density f with respect to length.
sentences.zh: 令随机变量X相对于长度具有概率密度f。

sentences.en: Assume the distribution is absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure and its density integrates to one.
sentences.zh: 假设分布相对于Lebesgue测度绝对连续，且密度积分为一。

sentences.en: Assume also that the entropy integral exists and is finite.
sentences.zh: 并假设熵积分存在且有限。

sentences.en: Define differential entropy h of X as negative the integral of f log two f.
sentences.zh: 定义微分熵h(X)=−∫f(x)log₂f(x)dx。

sentences.en: Unlike discrete entropy, this quantity can be negative.
sentences.zh: 与离散熵不同，该量可以为负。

sentences.en: Consider a uniform random variable from zero to a positive length, denoted by A.
sentences.zh: 考虑[0,a]上的均匀随机变量，其中a>0。

sentences.en: Its density is one divided by that interval length.
sentences.zh: 其在区间内的密度为1/a。

sentences.en: The log density equals negative log base two of A.
sentences.zh: 其密度对数为−log₂a。

sentences.en: Averaging over total probability one gives log base two of A for the differential entropy.
sentences.zh: 对总概率为一的区域积分，得到h=log₂a。

sentences.en: For interval length two, entropy is one bit.
sentences.zh: 当a=2时，微分熵为一比特。

sentences.en: For interval length one, entropy is zero.
sentences.zh: 当a=1时，微分熵为零。

sentences.en: For interval length one quarter, entropy is negative two bits.
sentences.zh: 当a=1/4时，微分熵为负二比特。

sentences.en: No probability became negative in that example.
sentences.zh: 该例中没有任何概率变成负数。

sentences.en: A density can exceed one because it is probability per unit length.
sentences.zh: 密度可以大于一，因为它表示单位长度上的概率。

sentences.en: Only the density integrated over a region is a probability.
sentences.zh: 只有密度在区域上积分后才是概率。

sentences.en: A density value is not itself constrained to be below one.
sentences.zh: 密度取值本身不受必须小于一的限制。

sentences.en: Discrete entropy is nonnegative, but differential entropy has no such lower bound.
sentences.zh: 离散熵非负，但微分熵没有这样的下界。

sentences.en: Changing units shifts its numerical value without changing the underlying probabilities.
sentences.zh: 改变单位会平移其数值，却不改变底层概率。

sentences.en: The numerical entropy also depends on coordinate units.
sentences.zh: 微分熵的数值还依赖坐标单位。

sentences.en: Changing from meters to centimeters scales this interval length.
sentences.zh: 将米改成厘米会改变区间长度a。

sentences.en: The formula then shifts entropy by the logarithm of that scale.
sentences.zh: 公式会使熵按该尺度的对数发生平移。

sentences.en: Quantization gives one way to see this scale dependence.
sentences.zh: 量化提供了一种观察尺度依赖的方法。

sentences.en: Divide the interval into aligned cells of width delta.
sentences.zh: 将区间划分为宽度δ且对齐的格子。

sentences.en: Suppose the interval length is an integer multiple of delta.
sentences.zh: 假设a是δ的整数倍。

sentences.en: Every cell then has probability delta over a.
sentences.zh: 此时每个格子的概率均为δ/a。

sentences.en: The interval length divided by delta gives the number of equally likely cells.
sentences.zh: 共有a/δ个等概率格子。

sentences.en: Their discrete entropy is log base two of that cell count.
sentences.zh: 其离散熵为log₂(a/δ)。

sentences.en: This equals log base two of the interval length, plus log base two of one over delta.
sentences.zh: 这等于log₂a+log₂(1/δ)。

sentences.en: Thus quantized entropy equals differential entropy plus log resolution.
sentences.zh: 因此量化熵等于微分熵加上分辨率对数。

sentences.en: Here the equality is exact because the density is uniform and cells align.
sentences.zh: 此处等式精确成立，因为密度均匀且格子对齐。

sentences.en: For a general density, the approximation needs regularity conditions.
sentences.zh: 对一般密度，该近似需要正则条件。

sentences.en: An arbitrary density does not automatically satisfy every quantization limit.
sentences.zh: 任意密度并不自动满足所有量化极限。

sentences.en: Differential entropy is not invariant under rescaling coordinates.
sentences.zh: 微分熵在坐标缩放下并不保持不变。

sentences.en: This differs from the entropy of a discrete label.
sentences.zh: 这与离散标签的熵不同。

sentences.en: Next, compute exactly how a smooth invertible map changes the value.
sentences.zh: 接下来精确计算光滑可逆映射如何改变微分熵。

scenes.title: The Jacobian records local volume expansion

sentences.en: Let X be a continuous vector in d dimensions.
sentences.zh: 令X为d维连续随机向量。

sentences.en: Let g be a continuously differentiable diffeomorphism between open domains containing the relevant support.
sentences.zh: 令g为包含相关支撑集的开区域之间的连续可微微分同胚。

sentences.en: Assume its Jacobian determinant is nonzero throughout that support.
sentences.zh: 假设其Jacobian行列式在该支撑集上处处非零。

sentences.en: Assume the relevant entropy integrals are finite.
sentences.zh: 假设相关熵积分均有限。

sentences.en: Also assume the expected log absolute Jacobian is finite.
sentences.zh: 并假设Jacobian绝对值对数的期望有限。

sentences.en: Write U equal to g of X.
sentences.zh: 记U=g(X)。

sentences.en: The density change formula divides f X by the absolute Jacobian determinant.
sentences.zh: 密度换元公式将f_X除以Jacobian行列式绝对值。

sentences.en: At u equals g of x, f U equals f X divided by the Jacobian magnitude.
sentences.zh: 在u=g(x)处，f_U(u)=f_X(x)/|detJ_g(x)|。

sentences.en: Take negative log two of both sides.
sentences.zh: 对两边取−log₂。

sentences.en: The transformed surprisal equals input surprisal plus log two absolute determinant.
sentences.zh: 变换后的自信息等于输入自信息加log₂|detJ|。

sentences.en: Average with respect to X.
sentences.zh: 再按X的分布取期望。

sentences.en: This yields h of g X equals h of X plus expected log two absolute determinant.
sentences.zh: 由此得到h(g(X))=h(X)+Elog₂|detJ_g(X)|。

sentences.en: For a scalar scaling g of x equals c x, the determinant magnitude is absolute c.
sentences.zh: 若标量变换g(x)=cx，行列式绝对值就是|c|。

sentences.en: Thus h of c X equals h of X plus log two absolute c.
sentences.zh: 因此h(cX)=h(X)+log₂|c|。

sentences.en: In d dimensions, scaling every coordinate by c adds d log two absolute c.
sentences.zh: 在d维中每个坐标乘c，会增加dlog₂|c|。

sentences.en: Now let X,Y have a joint density, and transform each separately by such invertible maps.
sentences.zh: 现在令X、Y具有联合密度，并分别进行这样的可逆变换。

sentences.en: The joint entropy gains the expected log Jacobian for both maps.
sentences.zh: 联合熵增加两个映射的期望Jacobian对数。

sentences.en: The marginal entropy of X gains its own Jacobian term.
sentences.zh: X的边缘熵增加其自身Jacobian项。

sentences.en: The marginal entropy of Y gains its corresponding term.
sentences.zh: Y的边缘熵增加对应的Jacobian项。

sentences.en: Mutual information is h X plus h Y minus h X,Y. Which Jacobian corrections survive?
sentences.zh: 互信息是h(X)+h(Y)−h(X,Y)。哪些雅可比修正项会留下？

sentences.en: The two marginal corrections cancel the joint correction.
sentences.zh: 两个边缘修正项抵消联合修正项。

sentences.en: Therefore mutual information is invariant under separate invertible transformations.
sentences.zh: 因此分别进行可逆变换不会改变互信息。

sentences.en: This argument requires the entropy differences to be finite.
sentences.zh: 该论证要求相关熵差有限。

sentences.en: Alternatively, the density-ratio Jacobians cancel directly in the mutual-information integral.
sentences.zh: 或者在互信息积分中，密度比里的Jacobian可直接抵消。

sentences.en: In the density ratio, the transformed joint density has both Jacobian factors.
sentences.zh: 在密度比中，变换后的联合密度含两个Jacobian因子。

sentences.en: The transformed marginal densities contain the matching individual factors.
sentences.zh: 变换后的边缘密度含有对应的单独因子。

sentences.en: Their cancellation explains invariance without subtracting infinite entropies.
sentences.zh: 这些因子抵消，因此无需相减无穷熵即可解释不变性。

sentences.en: A one-dimensional expansion by a factor of two adds exactly one bit.
sentences.zh: 一维扩张两倍恰好增加一比特。

sentences.en: A contraction by one half subtracts exactly one bit.
sentences.zh: 收缩为一半恰好减少一比特。

sentences.en: Both transformations must be invertible on the relevant supports.
sentences.zh: 两个变换都必须在相关支撑集上可逆。

sentences.en: We make no corresponding claim for noninvertible maps.
sentences.zh: 这里不对不可逆映射作相应断言。

sentences.en: A many-to-one map can discard information.
sentences.zh: 多对一映射可能丢失信息。

sentences.en: The Jacobian term measures local volume expansion or contraction.
sentences.zh: Jacobian项衡量局部体积的扩张或收缩。

sentences.en: This is why differential entropy changes with units.
sentences.zh: 这正是微分熵会随单位改变的原因。

sentences.en: Next, covariance eigenvalues summarize multidimensional Gaussian volume.
sentences.zh: 接下来用协方差特征值概括多维高斯体积。

sentences.en: Let X be a d-dimensional random vector with finite second moments.
sentences.zh: 令X为具有有限二阶矩的d维随机向量。

sentences.en: Its mean vector is mu.
sentences.zh: 其均值向量记为μ。

sentences.en: Define covariance K as the expected outer product of X minus mu with itself.
sentences.zh: 定义协方差K=E[(X−μ)(X−μ)^T]。

sentences.en: The matrix is symmetric and positive semidefinite.
sentences.zh: 该矩阵对称且半正定。

sentences.en: For a full-dimensional Gaussian density, assume K is positive definite.
sentences.zh: 若要有全维高斯密度，需假设K正定。

sentences.en: A real symmetric matrix has an orthogonal eigenvector basis.
sentences.zh: 实对称矩阵具有正交特征向量基。

sentences.en: Rotate coordinates into those principal directions.
sentences.zh: 将坐标旋转到这些主方向上。

sentences.en: The rotated covariance becomes diagonal.
sentences.zh: 旋转后的协方差变为对角矩阵。

sentences.en: Its diagonal entries are the eigenvalues lambda one through lambda d.
sentences.zh: 其对角元素就是特征值λ₁至λ_d。

sentences.en: Each eigenvalue gives variance along one principal axis.
sentences.zh: 每个特征值给出一个主轴方向上的方差。

sentences.en: An equal-Mahalanobis-distance surface is an ellipsoid.
sentences.zh: 等Mahalanobis距离曲面是一个椭球。

sentences.en: Its principal-axis lengths scale with square roots of eigenvalues.
sentences.zh: 其主轴长度按特征值平方根缩放。

sentences.en: The volume scales with the product of those axis lengths.
sentences.zh: 椭球体积按这些主轴长度的乘积缩放。

sentences.en: That product is proportional to square root of determinant K.
sentences.zh: 该乘积正比于√detK。

sentences.en: Rotation changes orientation but not determinant or volume.
sentences.zh: 旋转会改变方向，却不改变行列式或体积。

sentences.en: For positive eigenvalues, their product is determinant K.
sentences.zh: 特征值均为正时，其乘积就是detK。

sentences.en: The ellipsoid scale therefore depends on every principal direction.
sentences.zh: 因此椭球尺度取决于每个主方向。

sentences.en: The orientation alone cannot change its volume.
sentences.zh: 仅改变方向不会改变体积。

sentences.en: Covariance describes this spread, not the full distribution shape.
sentences.zh: 协方差描述这种离散程度，而非完整分布形状。

sentences.en: Different distributions can share the same covariance matrix.
sentences.zh: 不同分布可以具有相同协方差矩阵。

sentences.en: The Gaussian comparison will use covariance to fix its ellipsoid scale.
sentences.zh: 高斯比较将用协方差固定椭球尺度。

sentences.en: A large eigenvalue stretches the ellipsoid along its eigenvector.
sentences.zh: 较大特征值会沿对应特征向量拉长椭球。

sentences.en: A smaller positive eigenvalue makes the ellipsoid thinner. What happens when it reaches zero?
sentences.zh: 较小的正特征值让椭球更薄。它降到零时会发生什么？

sentences.en: If an eigenvalue reaches zero, the ellipsoid collapses onto a lower-dimensional set.
sentences.zh: 若某特征值降为零，椭球会压缩到低维集合。

sentences.en: Then K is singular and has no positive determinant.
sentences.zh: 此时K奇异，行列式不为正。

sentences.en: A Gaussian with singular covariance lies on a lower-dimensional affine subspace.
sentences.zh: 奇异协方差高斯分布落在低维仿射子空间上。

sentences.en: It has no density with respect to full-dimensional Lebesgue measure.
sentences.zh: 它相对于全维Lebesgue测度没有密度。

sentences.en: Therefore the usual full-dimensional Gaussian entropy formula does not apply.
sentences.zh: 因此通常的全维高斯熵公式不适用。

sentences.en: A lower-dimensional reference measure would be a different setup.
sentences.zh: 改用低维参考测度则是另一种设定。

sentences.en: Positive definiteness keeps every principal-axis variance strictly positive.
sentences.zh: 正定性保证每个主轴方差都严格为正。

sentences.en: It also permits the inverse covariance used in the Gaussian density.
sentences.zh: 它也保证高斯密度中的协方差逆矩阵存在。

sentences.en: The covariance determinant therefore controls the Gaussian volume scale.
sentences.zh: 因此协方差行列式控制高斯的体积尺度。

sentences.en: This geometric quantity will enter the entropy upper bound.
sentences.zh: 该几何量将进入熵上界。

sentences.en: Next, compare any density with the Gaussian having the same mean and covariance.
sentences.zh: 接下来将任意密度与同均值、同协方差的高斯比较。

scenes.title: Continuous KL reduces the proof to a quadratic expectation

sentences.en: Let X have a density f, mean mu, and positive-definite covariance K.
sentences.zh: 令X具有密度f、均值μ和正定协方差K。

sentences.en: Assume its differential entropy is finite.
sentences.zh: 假设其微分熵有限。

sentences.en: Let q be the Gaussian density with that same mean and covariance.
sentences.zh: 令q为具有相同均值与协方差的高斯密度。

sentences.en: Assume finite logarithmic expectations. In the scalar plot, is the Gaussian or matching uniform more entropic?
sentences.zh: 假设相关对数期望有限。在图中的标量例子里，同方差高斯分布与均匀分布谁的熵更大？

sentences.en: Continuous divergence is the integral of f times log two of f over q.
sentences.zh: 连续散度定义为∫f(x)log₂(f(x)/q(x))dx。

sentences.en: We first verify that this divergence is nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 先验证该散度非负。

sentences.en: For positive t, natural log t is at most t minus one.
sentences.zh: 对t>0，有ln t≤t−1。

sentences.en: Where f is positive, set t equal to q divided by f.
sentences.zh: 在f为正处，令t=q/f。

sentences.en: Multiply the inequality by f and integrate.
sentences.zh: 将不等式乘以f并积分。

sentences.en: The right side becomes the integral of q minus the integral of f.
sentences.zh: 右侧化为q的积分减去f的积分。

sentences.en: The f integral is one, while q integrates to at most one on that support.
sentences.zh: f积分为一，而q在该支撑集上的积分至多为一。

sentences.en: Thus the integral of f log f over q is nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 因此∫f ln(f/q)非负。

sentences.en: Changing to base two preserves the sign.
sentences.zh: 换成以2为底的对数不会改变符号。

sentences.en: Equality requires q equal f almost everywhere.
sentences.zh: 等号要求q=f几乎处处成立。

sentences.en: Write the Gaussian negative log density explicitly.
sentences.zh: 将高斯负对数密度显式写出。

sentences.en: It contains a constant involving two pi and determinant K.
sentences.zh: 其中常数项含2π与detK。

sentences.en: Its remaining term is the quadratic form using inverse K.
sentences.zh: 其余项是使用K逆矩阵的二次型。

sentences.en: The constant is one half log base two of two pi to dimension d, times determinant K.
sentences.zh: 常数项为0.5log₂((2π)^d detK)。

sentences.en: Add the quadratic form divided by two times natural log two.
sentences.zh: 再加上二次型除以2ln2。

sentences.en: Take expectation under f.
sentences.zh: 按照f取期望。

sentences.en: Write the quadratic form as a trace, then replace the expected outer product by covariance K.
sentences.zh: 将二次型写为迹，再将外积的期望换成协方差K。

sentences.en: The quadratic expectation equals the trace of K inverse times K.
sentences.zh: 二次型期望等于tr(K⁻¹K)。

sentences.en: That trace equals the dimension d.
sentences.zh: 该迹等于维数d。

sentences.en: So expected Gaussian negative log density is one half log two of (two pi e) to d times determinant K.
sentences.zh: 所以高斯负对数密度期望为0.5log₂((2πe)^d detK)。

sentences.en: This value is the entropy of q.
sentences.zh: 该值就是q的微分熵。

sentences.en: The divergence equals Gaussian entropy minus the entropy of f.
sentences.zh: 散度等于高斯熵减去f的熵。

sentences.en: Nonnegativity gives h of X at most one half log two of (two pi e) to d determinant K.
sentences.zh: 由散度非负得h(X)≤0.5log₂((2πe)^d detK)。

sentences.en: Equality holds exactly when f equals the matching Gaussian almost everywhere.
sentences.zh: 等号当且仅当f几乎处处等于匹配高斯密度。

sentences.en: The covariance must be positive definite for this full-dimensional formula.
sentences.zh: 该全维公式要求协方差正定。

sentences.en: A singular Gaussian has no full-dimensional Lebesgue density.
sentences.zh: 奇异高斯没有全维Lebesgue密度。

sentences.en: Now bound determinant K using its diagonal entries.
sentences.zh: 现在用对角元素界定detK。

sentences.en: For positive-definite K, Hadamard gives determinant K at most the product of diagonal entries.
sentences.zh: 对正定K，Hadamard不等式给出detK≤对角元素之积。

sentences.en: View K as a Gram matrix of linearly independent vectors.
sentences.zh: 将K视为线性无关向量的Gram矩阵。

sentences.en: Gram-Schmidt replaces each vector by its orthogonal residual.
sentences.zh: Gram-Schmidt过程将每个向量替换为正交残差。

sentences.en: Each residual norm is at most the original norm.
sentences.zh: 每个残差范数都不超过原向量范数。

sentences.en: Their squared product gives determinant K.
sentences.zh: 残差范数平方的乘积给出detK。

sentences.en: Equality requires every residual to keep its original norm.
sentences.zh: 等号要求每个残差都保持原范数。

sentences.en: That happens exactly when the original vectors are mutually orthogonal.
sentences.zh: 这当且仅当原向量两两正交时发生。

sentences.en: For a positive-definite matrix, equality therefore requires K to be diagonal.
sentences.zh: 对正定矩阵，等号因此要求K为对角矩阵。

sentences.en: For a singular positive-semidefinite matrix, keep only the determinant inequality.
sentences.zh: 对奇异半正定矩阵，只保留行列式不等式。

sentences.en: Both sides may vanish even when the remaining block has off-diagonal terms.
sentences.zh: 即使其余子块仍有非对角项，两边也可能同时为零。

sentences.en: Equality in a zero-zero case does not imply that the matrix is diagonal.
sentences.zh: 两边同为零时的等号，并不蕴含矩阵为对角阵。

sentences.en: Next, turn Gaussian maximum entropy into an estimation-error lower bound.
sentences.zh: 接下来将高斯最大熵转化为估计误差下界。

scenes.title: Conditional entropy constrains every observation-based estimator

sentences.en: Let X be a scalar random variable and Y an observation.
sentences.zh: 令X为标量随机变量，Y为观测。

sentences.en: Choose an estimator g that depends only on Y.
sentences.zh: 选择只依赖Y的估计器g。

sentences.en: Define estimation error E as X minus g of Y.
sentences.zh: 定义估计误差E=X−g(Y)。

sentences.en: Assume mean-square error is finite.
sentences.zh: 假设均方误差有限。

sentences.en: Assume the relevant conditional and error differential entropies exist and are finite.
sentences.zh: 假设相关条件微分熵与误差微分熵存在且有限。

sentences.en: For each fixed observation y, subtracting g of y is a translation.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定观测y，减去g(y)只是平移。

sentences.en: Translation leaves the conditional density shape and entropy unchanged.
sentences.zh: 平移不改变条件密度形状与熵。

sentences.en: Therefore h of X given Y equals h of E given Y.
sentences.zh: 因此h(X|Y)=h(E|Y)。

sentences.en: Conditioning cannot increase differential entropy when these quantities are finite.
sentences.zh: 在这些量有限时，条件化不会增加微分熵。

sentences.en: Thus h of E given Y is at most h of E.
sentences.zh: 所以h(E|Y)≤h(E)。

sentences.en: Among scalar variables with fixed variance, the Gaussian has maximum entropy.
sentences.zh: 在方差固定的标量变量中，高斯熵最大。

sentences.en: Hence h of E is at most one half log base two of two pi e times the variance of E.
sentences.zh: 因此h(E)≤0.5log₂(2πe Var(E))。

sentences.en: Variance is no greater than the second moment.
sentences.zh: 方差不超过二阶矩。

sentences.en: If the error has nonzero mean, its second moment also includes squared bias.
sentences.zh: 若误差均值非零，其二阶矩还包含偏差平方。

sentences.en: Thus the final bound uses mean-square error rather than variance alone.
sentences.zh: 因此最终界使用均方误差，而非仅用方差。

sentences.en: So this is at most one half log two of two pi e times expected E squared.
sentences.zh: 所以它至多为0.5log₂(2πe E[E²])。

sentences.en: Combining the steps gives the entropy-to-MSE inequality.
sentences.zh: 合并这些步骤得到熵到均方误差的不等式。

sentences.en: The mean-square error is at least two to twice h of X given Y, divided by two pi e.
sentences.zh: 均方误差至少为2^(2h(X|Y))/(2πe)。

sentences.en: No independent additive-noise assumption was used.
sentences.zh: 推导没有使用独立加性噪声假设。

sentences.en: The estimator may be nonlinear and may depend on Y.
sentences.zh: 估计器可以是非线性的，也可以依赖Y。

sentences.en: An estimate allowed to observe X directly belongs to a different information setup.
sentences.zh: 允许直接观测X的估计，属于另一种可用信息设定。

sentences.en: The unconditional bound using h of X applies to constant estimates without observations.
sentences.zh: 使用h(X)的无条件界，适用于无观测时的常数估计。

sentences.en: Now examine an exact jointly Gaussian example.
sentences.zh: 现在看一个精确的联合高斯例子。

sentences.en: Let Y be standard Gaussian and E an independent, zero-mean Gaussian with variance one quarter.
sentences.zh: 令Y为标准高斯，E为与其独立、零均值且方差为1/4的高斯。

sentences.en: Set X equal to Y plus E and estimate X by g of Y equal to Y.
sentences.zh: 令X=Y+E，并以g(Y)=Y估计X。

sentences.en: The estimation error is exactly E and is independent of Y.
sentences.zh: 估计误差恰为E，且独立于Y。

sentences.en: The conditional variance of X given Y is one quarter.
sentences.zh: 给定Y时，X的条件方差为1/4。

sentences.en: Its conditional entropy is one half log two of two pi e over four.
sentences.zh: 其条件熵为0.5log₂(2πe/4)。

sentences.en: The error second moment is one quarter. Does any gap remain in this chain of inequalities?
sentences.zh: 误差二阶矩为四分之一。这串不等式还剩下任何松弛吗？

sentences.en: Every inequality in the chain is equality here.
sentences.zh: 此例中整条不等式链每一步都取等号。

sentences.en: This example verifies tightness for a specific observation model.
sentences.zh: 该例验证了特定观测模型下界的紧性。

sentences.en: It does not require independence in the general theorem.
sentences.zh: 一般定理并不要求独立性。

sentences.en: Next, use log-density averages to describe continuous typical volume.
sentences.zh: 接下来利用对数密度平均描述连续典型体积。

scenes.title: Probability mass and geometric volume are distinct

sentences.en: Let X one through X n be IID with density f.
sentences.zh: 令X₁到Xₙ为密度f下的IID样本。

sentences.en: Assume h of X is finite.
sentences.zh: 假设h(X)有限。

sentences.en: Also assume the absolute value of log two f of X has finite expectation.
sentences.zh: 并假设|log₂f(X)|的期望有限。

sentences.en: This condition permits the strong law for information density.
sentences.zh: 该条件允许对信息密度应用强大数定律。

sentences.en: The block density is the product of the n single-sample densities.
sentences.zh: 块密度等于n个单样本密度之积。

sentences.en: Take negative log two and divide by n.
sentences.zh: 取负对数并除以n。

sentences.en: The result is the sample average of negative log two f of X i.
sentences.zh: 所得结果是−log₂f(Xᵢ)的样本平均。

sentences.en: Each term has mean h of X.
sentences.zh: 每项的均值是h(X)。

sentences.en: The strong law makes the average converge almost surely to h.
sentences.zh: 强大数定律保证该平均几乎必然趋于h。

sentences.en: Fix epsilon greater than zero.
sentences.zh: 固定ε>0。

sentences.en: Call a block typical when its negative log density per coordinate lies within epsilon of h.
sentences.zh: 若每坐标负对数密度位于h的ε邻域内，就称该块典型。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the typicality test places each block density between two exponential bounds.
sentences.zh: 等价地，典型性检验将每个块密度限制在两个指数界之间。

sentences.en: For any delta between zero and one, sufficiently large n gives typical-set probability at least one minus delta.
sentences.zh: 任取0<δ<1，n充分大时典型集概率至少为1−δ。

sentences.en: The typical set is a subset of continuous n-dimensional space.
sentences.zh: 典型集是连续n维空间的一个子集。

sentences.en: Its probability mass is the integral of the block density over that set.
sentences.zh: 其概率质量是块密度在该集合上的积分。

sentences.en: On the set, density is at most two to negative n times h minus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 在该集合上，密度至多为2^(−n(h−ε))。

sentences.en: Therefore its mass is at most that density bound times its volume.
sentences.zh: 因此其质量至多为该密度上界乘以体积。

sentences.en: The volume is at least one minus delta times two to n times h minus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 因此体积至少为(1−δ)2^(n(h−ε))。

sentences.en: On the same set, density is at least two to negative n times h plus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 在同一集合上，密度至少为2^(−n(h+ε))。

sentences.en: Its mass cannot exceed one.
sentences.zh: 其质量不能超过一。

sentences.en: So volume is at most two to n times h plus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 所以体积至多为2^(n(h+ε))。

sentences.en: Together, these bounds place logarithmic volume per coordinate near h.
sentences.zh: 两界共同将每坐标对数体积限制在h附近。

sentences.en: First hold epsilon fixed and let n grow.
sentences.zh: 先固定ε并令n增大。

sentences.en: Then choose arbitrarily smaller positive epsilon.
sentences.zh: 随后再选择任意更小的正ε。

sentences.en: The volume exponent approaches differential entropy.
sentences.zh: 体积指数率趋于微分熵。

sentences.en: This is a geometric volume statement, not a probability-mass statement.
sentences.zh: 这是几何体积结论，不是概率质量结论。

sentences.en: It is also not a count of discrete sequences.
sentences.zh: 它也不是离散序列数量的计数。

sentences.en: Differential entropy can be negative. Can a set of probability one have vanishing coordinate volume?
sentences.zh: 微分熵可能为负。概率为一的集合，其坐标体积能趋于零吗？

sentences.en: For uniform zero to one quarter, h is negative two. The full block support has mass one and volume four to negative n.
sentences.zh: 对零到四分之一的均匀分布，h为负二。整个块支持集的概率为一，体积为4的负n次方。

sentences.en: A coordinate rescaling changes both density units and differential entropy.
sentences.zh: 坐标缩放会同时改变密度单位与微分熵。

sentences.en: The probability mass remains unchanged under the corresponding change of variables.
sentences.zh: 相应换元下概率质量保持不变。

sentences.en: Thus volume must always be interpreted with its coordinate units.
sentences.zh: 因此体积始终必须结合坐标单位解释。

sentences.en: The absolute-integrability assumption is not automatic for every density.
sentences.zh: 绝对可积假设并非对每个密度都自动成立。

sentences.en: Without it, this strong-law route may fail.
sentences.zh: 若不满足该条件，这条强大数定律证明路线可能失效。

sentences.en: The continuous AEP therefore has explicit regularity requirements.
sentences.zh: 因此连续AEP具有明确的正则条件。

sentences.en: Next, use Gaussian entropy bounds in channel models.
sentences.zh: 下一集将在信道模型中使用高斯熵界。
